description: Demo songs bundled with the Music Studio. Sourced from the Space Intruders homebrew project (https://paisleyboxers.itch.io/space-intruders) and used as example/test material.
credit: Music by paisleyboxers — used with permission as Music Studio demo content.

demos.title: Space Intruders — Title Theme
demos.blurb: 3-channel techno arpeggio (Em–G–D), tempo 6, clarinet X over Z bass pedal. The flagship title-screen track.

demos.title: Space Intruders — BG Mid
demos.blurb: Amen-break-flavored busy drum loops with acid bass riffs. Great showcase of the M1/M2/M3 drum mix.

demos.title: Dark Descent
demos.blurb: Chromatic, dissonant boss track. Heavy Z bass walks + sparse M1 kicks. Tempo 7, very slow and crushing.

demos.title: Grid Runner — Low
demos.blurb: Drum-and-bass styled gameplay loop. Two-bar pattern, drum-heavy.

demos.title: Grid Runner — High
demos.blurb: Faster/higher variant of the Grid Runner loop. Higher tension.

demos.title: Grid Runner — Original
demos.blurb: Original cut of the Grid Runner gameplay loop.

demos.title: Grid Runner — Gears
demos.blurb: Gears variation — tempo experiments inline (SPEED control).

demos.title: Starlight
demos.blurb: Slower atmospheric piece with sparser drums.

demos.title: Neon Cathedral
demos.blurb: Full-melody showcase track — 136 notes, no drums. Good demo of the three melody channels harmonizing.

demos.title: Grid Runner — Tempo Stubs
demos.blurb: Tempo reference / scaffolding file. Mostly silent — useful as a structural template.

demos.title: ECS Hex Choir
demos.blurb: 8-channel ECS showcase: 6-voice chord pad (C–Am–F–G) with stacked drum strips. Demonstrates the IntyBASIC 8-arg MUSIC syntax — written for this editor, not derived from any existing track.
